A text message that appears in the Chat window or Combat Log in yellow from the World of Warcraft game system as opposed to another Player character, NPC, or mob. A system message announcement almost always appears when you first log into the game.

.toc (Table of Contents) files contain information about a particular addon (such as its name, description, saved variables, etc), as well as instructions on how the addon should be loaded by the client (for example, the order in which lua and xml files should be loaded). The file must be present, and have the same name (plus extension) as its parent folder for the addon to be recognized by the client.

System requirements are the minimum level of hardware and software a player should have to expect a decent playing experience. Listing these requirements is an industry standard, but "decent" playing experience varies wildly. All the Warcraft games have varying levels of system requirements, but most of them run on both Microsoft Windows based PCs and Mac OS X based Macintosh computers.

Symphonic Chimekeeper is sold by the following vendors in Bastion for 1 Abominable Anima Spherule: *Alisius *Kelli Hoo *Provisioner Prothos *Battlemaster Endios
The Swoop Eggs are provided as an objective for Early Adoption. They can be placed in empty Swoop Nests.
Synvir Lockbox is a Revendreth world drop. Two are needed to buy Rat Soul from the Shopkeeper in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Symbols of Loyalty to Azshara would be disenchanted into Dust of Betrayal. They were to drop from: *Hatecoil Riptail *Hatecoil Stormcaller *Naga Brute
Sylla is a venthyr located at the Charred Ramparts in Revendreth. She's surrounded by her three battle pets: Ash, Fang, and Swarm.

The Synthesis Forge is a device located in a structure in the Droning Precipice in Zereth Mortis. It grants access to the Protoform Synthesis system once Protoform Synthesis (quest) has been completed.
Sylvan Striders are water striders located in Val'sharah. They are also present in the Ashamane's Fall arena.
Sylvan Bears are bears located in Val'sharah. They are also present in the Ashamane's Fall arena.
Synthesized! is an exploration achievement earned by crafting a protoform creature.
Syringe of Bloodborne Infirmity drops from Vectis in Uldir. It is also looted from Cache of Uldir Treasures.
Synthe-fived! is an exploration achievement earned by crafting five different protoform creatures at Zereth Mortis's protoform forges.
Synthe-superfived! is an exploration achievement earned by crafting twenty-five different protoform creatures at Zereth Mortis's protoform forges.
Synthe-supersized! is an exploration achievement earned by crafting fifty different protoform creatures at Zereth Mortis's protoform forges.
Symbol of the Vombata is a quest reward from Technical Difficulties. It also drops from Sorranos just south of Haven in Zereth Mortis.
Symbol of the Lupine is a quest reward from Technical Difficulties. It also drops from Vexis in the Great Veldt in Zereth Mortis.
Symbol of the Raptora is a quest reward from Technical Difficulties. It also drops from Garudeon at Garudeon's Nest in Zereth Mortis.
Synchronous Oracular Mantle is a quest reward from Cyphers of the First Ones (quest).
Synchronous Cryptic Shoulderpads are a quest reward from Cyphers of the First Ones (quest).

The Syntactic Seal is found in a cave beneath the entrance to the Sepulcher of the First Ones in Zereth Mortis. With six stacks of Syllabic Recall obtained from the nearby Runic Syllables, the Syntactic Vault can be accessed.

Sylvari Artisans are sylvar located in the Ring of Fates in Oribos during Prisoner of Interest.

Swollen Bark Clasp drops from Treemouth in Brackenhide Hollow.

Swoop Nests are found in northern Desolace. When Swoop Eggs are placed in the nest, hostile Snapjaw Basilisks or Famished Bonepaws will appear.
Swollen Voidwalkers are voidwalkers located in Thunder Ridge in Durotar.
